title: The row of icon previews stays up when you pick nothing
goal: While you are drawing an icon, a row of small previews at the top left of the canvas shows it at the sizes it will really be used. Click an empty part of the canvas, or press Escape, and the whole row vanishes, because it only knows which icon to show from whatever is selected. Deselecting is the ordinary way to stand back and look at what you have drawn, and it is exactly the moment the previews are worth most. Keep them up.
acceptance: Draw inside an icon frame, then click empty canvas or press Escape: the previews row is still there and still shows that icon
With the pointer over a different icon frame and nothing picked, the row shows that frame's icon, the same way the Width row already decides
A document with no icon frame in it still draws no previews and pays nothing for them
A scripted walk covers deselecting with an icon frame open, so this cannot come back
The try path: New Frame, pick an icon size, draw a shape in it, press Escape. Ships in Next behind next-icon-previews, which is on by default
anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not
